description.text: One of the two expansions released on 26 January 2024, together with Cyber Judge, in which the Ancient and Future Pokémon fully awaken. Its Ancient Pokémon ex are ancient forms of the legendary Pokémon of Johto, Gouging Fire ex, Raging Bolt ex and Walking Wake ex, with Flutter Mane, Roaring Moon and the Supporter Explorer's Guidance. These two packs also brought back ACE SPEC cards, so strong that a deck may hold only one, for the first time in eleven years since the Black & White series, now with their own rarity, ACE: here Awakening Drum, Maximum Belt and the Special Energy Neo Upper Energy. Gengar ex, Torterra ex and the Tera Pokémon Wugtrio ex join them, with Team Star's Eri as a Supporter for the first time and Morty's Conviction. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 71, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Gouging Fire ex, Walking Wake ex and Raging Bolt ex. In English most of its cards came out in Temporal Forces in March 2024.
